description: Is the brand's search data (Google Search Console / Bing) connected, and what did the last roadmap reconcile do? Returns {connected, hasData, connections, reconcile: {status, trigger, finishedAt, summary} | null, roadmap: {refreshOpen, refreshTotal, hidden, withSearchData}}. summary has movedUp / nowCovered / newKeywords / newTopics / refreshItems counts. reconcile=null means it never ran. Call this before seo_search_data_reconcile, and again to poll it (status generating -> completed | failed). To see the items: seo_list_roadmap with type="refresh" (pages to rewrite) or status="ignored" (hidden as already covered).
name: seo_search_data_status
